description: This file is a non-Sizzle selector module for jQuery, providing custom selector functionalities with limited features, mainly for smaller builds. It includes functions for element matching, sorting, text extraction, containment checks, and attribute handling.

methods.name: find
methods.description: Finds elements matching a selector within a context, with optional seed results.

methods.name: unique
methods.description: Removes duplicate elements from a results array.

methods.name: text
methods.description: Retrieves the text content from an element or array of elements.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if element a contains element b.

methods.name: isXMLDoc
methods.description: Determines if a document is an XML document.
